name: Wenatchee River (Leavenworth – Cashmere)
blurb: Leavenworth's summer river — tubes and SUPs in town, big-water rafting rapids below Dryden.

sections.notes: Mostly Class II. Boulder Bend (Class III, AW mile ~2.9) can be sneaked on the right. Wood collects along the left shore. Discover Pass required at Peshastin (WDFW). Leavenworth Waterfront Park is free (AW).

notices.title: This is the downstream whitewater trip
notices.text: Waterfront Park offers river recreation, but this listed trip continues downstream through Class II–III water. It is not the city’s separate upstream summer shuttle float. Scout current conditions and choose equipment and skills for the entire section.

putInAccess.note: The city invites floating at Waterfront Park, and its public facility listing identifies the Beach Area at 997 Main Street. Individual imagery matches the existing research candidate to the wooded park between Main Street parking and the Wenatchee. No single beach is selected as an exact launch. City hours are 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; restrooms close for winter around October 15. This downstream Class II–III section is distinct from the city’s gentler upstream river-shuttle float.
putInAccess.directions: Reach the city’s Waterfront Park beach area from 997 Main Street and the public park paths. Carry your craft to an open river entry; several beaches are present. The marker is the park vicinity, not a vehicle ramp or the separate access across the river.

takeOutAccess.operator: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife
takeOutAccess.sourceName: WDFW Facilities GIS, Hand Launch layer (feature 57, 'Peshastin')
takeOutAccess.note: Batch 2. Coordinate is WDFW's own hand-launch feature. Esri World Imagery (z19, checked 2026-10-25, research/raw/batch2/peshastin.png) puts it a few metres from the Wenatchee. Legal access: WDFW Peshastin page (https://wdfw.wa.gov/places-to-go/water-access-sites/peshastin-708) lists no boat ramp, 1 hand launch, 1 parking lot, open year-round; WaterAccessSites layer (https://geodataservices.wdfw.wa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/WP_RealEstate/WaterAccessSites/FeatureServer/1) shows WDFW-managed, no closure. Hand-carry only. Pass required.
takeOutAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHDPlus HR flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
takeOutAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~57), the hand launch is left of the NHD centreline. Confirmed on imagery.

sections.notes: Launch BELOW Dryden Dam — the dam is a deadly hydraulic; anyone coming from upstream must use the river-right portage (Chelan PUD). Rodeo Hole (III+), Drunkard's Drop, Turkey Shoot, Snowblind and Granny's (III). Dryden is a WDFW access: Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass required. Cashmere Riverside Park fee status not confirmed.
